evidence.whyNotSweepMeasurement: The Install control renders only for a region with placed locations that no installed pack covers, and only for manage_platform. No sweep fixture places customer locations, and the live install has none placed, so a sweep of /customer?view=map would measure the panel without the control. The placement was decided among three options instead.
evidence.notes: Adds one secondary 'Install this street map' button per uncovered region on the existing Street maps list (BI-8C76920D) in the administrator-only geocoding panel, and one status line while an install runs. No new route, tab, panel or navigation. The default customer view is unchanged for non-administrators and when every region is covered.
